verses.1: To be destroyed by the skillful music of David.
verses.2: When the enemies came, they said to Shaul, “David is with us now.”
verses.3: May God, in your name, save me, and may you judge me with your authority.
verses.4: God has heard my prayers. He listens to what I say.
verses.5: For strangers have risen against me, and they demand my soul. But God has not placed any resistance against them.
verses.6: Look, God has helped me, my Lord, through the trials of my soul.
verses.7: The wicked will be put back in their proper places, in your true nature.
verses.8: In thanksgiving, I offer you my worship; may your name be glorified, O LORD. For it is good.
verses.9: For from all dangers he saved me; in all difficulties, my eyes saw.
